name: AliaSpaces
intro: Explore AliaSpaces through three distinct modes while keeping the relationship to your MyPersonas account clear.
features: Website opens the existing MyPersonas owner command center with its owner controls retained.
Social opens the first-party social client; sign-in and review gates still apply.
Local opens device-only social examples and Akasha history, reflection notes and reversible library views.
demo: Start in Website to see the real service, or choose Local to inspect the demonstration.
Check the mode label before entering information or expecting shared-account behavior.
Use Social only with the understanding that a verified session and review rules are required. This guide creates no account or post.
setup: Choose the mode appropriate to what you want to test.
Have your shared MyPersonas credentials and MFA available for real sign-in.
Confirm the selected account and mode before using online features.
boundary: Website, Social and Local are different experiences. Local demo records are not online posts. Production authorization, moderation and multi-account privacy still need release verification.
privacy: Personal records, notes and backups stay outside the installer. View rules do not delete history or change external feeds. This guide performs no sign-in, linking or publication.
